title: the agent side of the record: what it can reach, what it was authorised to do, and the gap
summary: The record covered how the identities were built. This adds what the agent standing on them can actually do: thirty connector tools measured from their own schemas, ten of them unprompted; a mandate inferred from one session and marked as inferred; and barriers separated into the kind that stop an uncooperative agent and the kind that only guide a cooperative one.
